title: Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases: Referral to Foreclosure Counsel
content:
**Conditions.** A Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case is referred to foreclosure counsel only when all of the following hold:

- the loan has not been satisfied;
- no cure has been accepted;
- no extension is pending a HUD decision.

**Earliest day.** A case is referred only on or after the day after the current resolution deadline. That day is the resolution deadline plus the plan's referral days after the deadline, counted in calendar days, and the referral is allowed on that day itself. The authority is the resolution deadline on Cedarline's case record, not a date given by a caller.

**Notice period.** A referral also needs a foreclosure referral notice sent at least the plan's foreclosure referral notice days, in calendar days, earlier. When the notice was sent later than that, the referral waits until the notice period has run.

**Completion first.** A referral never stops a payoff, sale or deed in lieu that completes before the foreclosure sale. Such a completion resolves the case instead.

## Earliest referral day, both sides (hypothetical; one-day figure, notice sent well ahead)

| Resolution deadline | Proposed referral day | Allowed? |
|---|---|---|
| 15 April | 15 April | no, it is the deadline day itself |
| 15 April | 16 April | yes, it is the day after the deadline |
| 15 April | 20 April | yes |

## Notice period, worked through (hypothetical; 30-day figure)

The resolution deadline is 15 April, so the earliest referral day is 16 April. The referral notice was sent on 1 April. Thirty calendar days from 1 April is 1 May, so the referral waits until 1 May.
